notes.title: Some New Development Updates!
notes.content:
Hey there! 
While it's been some time since the last update, development has continued steadily, and I've continued to work on the game everyday since then!
Development of the game's demo is nearing the finish line, and tons of improvements have been made since I last set up the Steam page!

A trailer is coming soon to show off all the new updates, but while that's being prepared, I wanted to give a sneak peak in this post here 👀

So here's a quick update on all the new changes and content! 

Updated visuals/environments!
The visuals have been updated to give things more of a modern anime look! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40664030/f873fd54ceba7d97b799417fe679375957f6f237.jpg


New accessibility features!
Worried puzzles might be hard or tricky? No problem!
I've been adding some accessibility features to make the puzzles more manageable for folks who might need it! For example, you can now rewind all your actions, so no need to worry about getting things right on the first try!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40664030/920d9ce29114f084d7c4c42430c3cc0cf472cacb.gif

And new ways to interact....?
And some secret features that aren't quiiiiiite ready to share just yet, but that I'm super pumped for and that I hope you'll look forward to too! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40664030/ff566ec7c98bd43e02feed47a8939e442d687bb6.jpg


I'll keep it at that for now, but there's a bunch more that's been added/currently being added, so look forward to more updates soon! 
A sincere thanks to anyone who's kept up with the game's development and is reading updates like this! 
It makes me so happy to have your continued interest, and I'm so eager to share this game with you all soon. I want to do my best to make something that'll make the wait worth it! 🙇‍♂️
 
Thank you!!

notes.title: Dev Update - September
notes.content:
Hey hey hey! Here with another update!

Planning planning planning......
Been a minute since I posted any development updates. That's mainly because I've spent the last few months going hardcore in planning the "on-paper" details for the game. Things like writing dialogue, outlining the plot, designing puzzles, among a few other behind the scenes details.

The good news as that most of the important details have been figured out and locked in! 
So that means I've been able to dive back into developing new mechanics and new levels for the full game.

New item: Copy-Paste!
While the game is centered around freezing and unfreezing objects in time, there'll be a few other items with their own unique mechanics and puzzles as well.

The first one I'd like to share is the clipboard & paintbrush!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40664030/4793440ec0e1a2f81fac10ef443f6730ed0d6608.gif

This item allows you to copy the material of one object and paste it onto another. You can use this to make things bouncy, floaty, heavy, as well as few other adjective ending in "y".
And the idea will be to use these for clearing obstacles and reaching keys that let you get to the next level! 
These different items will also be tied to other characters featured in the game. 

Meet Penny!
So far, gameplay footage and artwork has mainly focused on Ai. While she is the protagonist, there'll be plenty of characters she meets on her journey who are central to the story.

And so with this update, I'd like to share the first of those characters: Penny Doolum!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40664030/257c95084ddb696476d7a9f919a9de8fb1a3a461.png

She's a member of the school's art club, and particularly loves painting. The only problem is, she tends to overthink just about everything. From what color socks to wear, to what sort of scenes she should paint. This leads her to be quite indecisive, and so she tends to spend way more time standing in front of a blank canvas than actually painting anything 😅

She's just one of many folks Ai will meet on her journey to find love, and I hope you can look forward to seeing what sort of role Penny will play in the game's story :)

Wrap-up
Apologies again for the delay between updates! The plan now though is to keep working directly on developing new content prepping for the demo release!

Also, the best place to stay most up to date would be the DokiToki Discord server, and second best place is the game's Twitter!

That's all for now, thanks for reading and I hope you have a nice day! :)

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
Introduction
From the start I've set out to have anime-style visuals to go with the anime-inspired premise and characters. And little by little I've been working toward achieving that style while also making things more aesthetically pleasing. It's probably the one aspect that's being improved and tweaked most frequently, and if you've seen the Steam page change over time, you've probably already noticed some of these modifications!

Environments
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40664030/c569debe6904bfbd3d0b242cf99afa62d09346ad.png
From the start, the hallways and classrooms have been built on simple blocky shapes, but now they've been given toon shaders to help makes things pop. Plus some light rays and other particles falling through the windows to recreate the feel of a school hallway on a bright, sunny morning seen in the countless high school themed anime.


Items
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40664030/52dc897248b052d2cc67f5953c300246945fa191.png
The game is all about freezing, unfreezing, and manipulating objects in time. Therefore, a key point is how these items are presented. They've been given a subtle pink glow and bright white outlines to fit with the new style of the surrounding environments. 


Characters
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40664030/06ed9bea0c81c9cb0ffdffb7eae7d3143e90a311.png
Lastly, the artwork for the characters has been given an upgrade too! These will be used for the in game sprites during the dialogue scenes, and a couple other UI-related features.


That's it for this post! With how the visuals are always being tweaked an upgraded, I could probably make every update post about visual changes, haha, but really, the main point here is that the visuals are always changing little by little, so keep an eye out. 

With that said, the plan for the next post is to focus on more technical aspects. Particularly some gameplay mechanics used for solving puzzles.

Thanks for reading, and I hope you have a good day!
